disambiguation: Not a general list generator; it specifically creates a tree skeleton of links within callouts.
extras: Be aware that concurrent edits on multiple devices using file sync could lead to sync conflicts, although the plugin attempts to handle this.
intentEvidence: TreeKeeper makes every folder note link to its children automatically.
motivation: To automate the creation and maintenance of MOC link lists, ensuring the folder tree is fully connected and visible in the graph view.
problem: Manually maintaining a complete and accurate list of links between folder notes and their children is tedious and error-prone.

relations.evidence: TreeKeeper and Folder Note pair well: Folder Note opens a folder as its note, TreeKeeper keeps the links between those notes alive.
Waypoint takes a similar idea in a different direction — recursive lists of a folder's contents instead of the tree skeleton.

summary: TreeKeeper automatically adds dictionary-sorted wikilinks to the tail of folder notes, connecting the vault's MOC tree and making the graph view reflect the folder structure.
